title: Tagged at Four Pounds Fifty
subject: a Saturday volunteer at a charity shop who prices a gold sequin jacket from the donation bags at four pounds fifty, then buys it herself and wears it on the till before the shop opens
caption: Indie sleaze dance-punk, late-2000s DFA and nu-rave style. Four-on-the-floor disco-punk drums with cowbell, scratchy clean funk guitar, distorted synth bass, handclaps on the backbeat. Blown-out compressed club mix, sweaty room energy. Female alto, clearly sung melody, deadpan verses into a shouted-sung chorus. 126 BPM, A minor. Giddy, cheeky, danceable. No trap, no autotune, no EDM drops, no ballad sections, no orchestral strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - cowbell, synth bass]

[Verse 1]
Saturday, eight o'clock, back room
Black bags and a broken broom
One bag splits and there it is
Gold sequins and a smell of fizz

[Pre-Chorus]
The price gun clicks in my hand
I'm not proud and I don't care

[Chorus]
Four pounds fifty, it's mine, it's mine
I'm wearing it on the till at nine
Margaret says that's not allowed
I'm dancing for the empty crowd

[Verse 2]
Paid in coins from my own purse
Put the receipt in the cardigan drawer
The sleeves are long, the zip is worse
I'm a disco ball on the shop floor

[Pre-Chorus]
Margaret's rummaging out the back
She's holding up the matching slacks

[Chorus]
Four pounds fifty, it's mine, it's mine
I'm wearing it on the till at nine
Margaret's laughing, takes a bow
She's in the sequin trousers now

[Outro - cowbell, handclaps fade]
